overlay.intro: Overlays show per-move scores from neural networks and databases, helping you understand and analyse each position. Select up to three in the analysis panel dropdowns; toggle diagnostic chips for additional annotation layers.
overlay.section_net_desc: Three dropdown slots in the analysis panel. Each colours move arrows on the board by the selected model's score for that move.
overlay.section_diag_desc: Toggle buttons in the analysis panel. Each adds an annotation layer to all legal moves simultaneously, and can be combined with the net-slot overlays.
overlay.sentinel_what: Scores each legal move 0–1 (1 = winning, 0 = losing) from the current player's perspective.
overlay.sentinel_how: Trained on AI vs AI and human games with Malom database win/draw/loss labels. A contrastive ranking loss ensures winning moves rank above losing moves within each position.
overlay.gapnet_what: Estimates positional vulnerability after each move. Lower G: scores indicate safer resulting positions.
overlay.gapnet_how: Trained on game outcome data to identify positional gaps. GapNet v3 is a calibrated neural network; v1 is an older fallback if v3 is unavailable.
overlay.value_what: Predicts the long-term win probability of the resulting position. Higher V: = stronger position for the mover.
overlay.value_how: Phase-specific model (v3): separate networks for placement, movement, and fly phases, trained with DTW-weighted game outcome targets. Promotes decisive outcomes.
overlay.pref_what: Ranks moves by how likely a human player is to choose them. F: values are normalised probabilities.
overlay.pref_how: Trained on over 22,000 human games (640,000+ positions) using a pairwise ranking loss. Strongest in constrained late-game positions where move choices are limited.
overlay.pred_what: Predicted probability (%) that a human player at the selected Elo band would play each move. Use the band selector to filter by strength.
overlay.pred_how: Teacher v4 model, trained with log-scaled branching-factor weighting. Achieves significantly better accuracy on high-branching positions (openings, early midgame) than earlier models.
overlay.teacher_what: Same data as Pred — Teacher v4 predicted human move probability — shown in a different colour so it can be used alongside the Pred slot.
overlay.teacher_how: The Teacher model also serves as a training opponent for the Generalist AI at a 25% humanlike blend, contributing human-style move diversity to self-play.
overlay.generalist_what: Probability (%) that the Generalist AI would pick each move in this position. Gen: 100% means it always picks that move here.
overlay.generalist_how: ScaffoldedPolicyNet trained through reinforcement learning with heuristic scaffolding and 25% human-teacher opponent blending. Expert features include Sentinel scores, heuristic evaluations, and Malom WDL signals.
overlay.regret_what: How much worse a move is compared to the Malom-optimal move, in depth-to-mate units. R: 0 = optimal. Higher values = more costly deviation.
overlay.regret_how: Computed directly from the Malom perfect database (DTM values). Only meaningful when Malom is installed. Requires Malom DB to be configured in Databases.
overlay.static_what: Tactic bonus (mill threats, piece count, mobility) plus position evaluation for each move. Instant — no lookahead.
overlay.static_how: Classic NMM heuristic function used by the AI engine for move ordering. Useful for a quick sanity check of the tactical situation.
overlay.negamax_what: Alpha-beta search score for each move at the selected depth (default 3 plies). Slower to compute — refreshes once per position request.
overlay.negamax_how: Uses the same negamax engine as the AI player, with transposition table and move ordering. Disabled while the AI is calculating its own move.
overlay.traj_what: T: = % of human games in the database that used this move from this exact position. P: = Teacher v4 model probability when no trajectory data exists for a move (T:—).
overlay.traj_how: T: data is indexed from 22,000+ human games. When a position has never been seen in the database, P: falls back to the Teacher v4 model for an Elo-conditioned estimate.
overlay.db_what: WIN (green) or LOSS (red) arrows from the endgame and Malom databases. Shows M# (moves to forced mate) where Malom data is available.
overlay.db_how: Three layers: FullGame DB (common human game positions), retrograde Endgame DB (all ≤11-piece positions, perfectly solved), and the Malom perfect database (complete game tree). Malom requires separate installation.
overlay.pressure_what: For each move you can make, shows L: % (green) of opponent responses that are losing for them, and W: % (red) that are winning for them. Choose moves that maximise L:.
overlay.pressure_how: Computed from the Malom perfect database by evaluating all opponent responses to each candidate move. Requires Malom DB. Helps identify moves that give the opponent the most chances to err.
overlay.overseer_what: O: % — how likely the Generalist AI is to choose each move in this position. Highlights the AI's preferred move and probability distribution across alternatives.
overlay.overseer_how: Same ScaffoldedPolicyNet as the Generalist net-slot overlay, displayed as a chip annotation rather than a colour scale. The chip button is dimmed if the Generalist model has not loaded.
